text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the cafeteria, I 
spotted Nice Nature watching a group of 
horse girls laughing and playing from a 
slight distance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling conversations, beaming smiles. 
Yep, yep, that's an afternoon at Tracen 
Academy for ya——

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Natureeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...And that's also an afternoon at Tracen 
Academy, huh. What is it, Turbo? What's 
up?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! Turbo is gonna! Do 
"promoshun"!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Like the thing Teio and McQueen are gonna 
do soon!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~! Come to think of it, those two are 
filming something for an academy 
promotional shoot, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Promotions are pretty much the pinnacle of 
the glamorous life. ...Seriously, they're 
amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If Teio's doing it, Turbo is doing it too! 
So, I'm gonna promoshun the academy!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right, I see. You just want to copy them. 
Well, I don't really get it, but good luck 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't just say good luck!! Nature, you 
gotta do it with me!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
C'monnn! Pleeeease! Let's do the promoshun 
together!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gah... you're relentless! I said I'm not 
doing it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Why not, why not?! Turbo wants Nature to 
come along too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
'Cause Nature is reliable and fun and 
hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you want reliable, go ask Ikuno, and if 
you want fun and hilarious, you've got 
Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Those two already said okay! I totally 
want Nature with us too~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's wear super cool outfits like Teio 
and take photos~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Talk about pushy...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's really just not my thing. Jeez, what 
am I supposed to do——

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey there, Trainer-san! Could you do 
something about Turbo here?!
choice_data_list: Forcing her isn't good, you know.
Forcing her isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey there, Trainer-san! Could you do 
something about Turbo here?!
choice_data_list: Forcing her isn't good, you know.
Forcing her isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! If you say that, then——

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, Nature!! Give it a try, give it a 
tryyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See, now you've got her all riled up! 
There's no stopping her once she gets like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, fine, I get it, just calm down! 
I'll do it, alright? I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san, you're definitely taking 
responsibility later for instigating this, 
got it?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Forsing?! What does forsing mean?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It means making someone do something they 
don't want to do!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! Nature, you didn't wanna do the 
promoshun?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Kh. Well—— Of course I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuu~~ you don't wanna... *slump*.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I feel a bit bad for Turbo, but thanks. 
You saved me. Now I can go back to my 
usual peace and quiet~...
